errors.evidence: The machine description states that the number of COVID-19-related news articles ranges from 1,000 to 5,000, but the chart shows values ranging from approximately 1,000 to 6,000.
The machine description does not mention the observed lag effect between peaks in confirmed cases and peaks in news reporting, which is highlighted in the reference description.
